mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 15, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. UK sanctions on Israel 'fall far short' of its obligations, legal experts say. More than 130 sign letter to PM saying international law requires further measures to stop illegal settlements More than 130 legal experts, including 18 king's counsel (KCs), have written to Andy Burnham saying that sanctions on Israeli settlements "fall far short" of Britain's obligations under the international court of justice's (ICJ's) finding that the occupation is unlawful. This was reported by The Guardian. For the full source-backed dispatch, read the September 15, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
